headline: Multiplayer shares items and planets, smooths remote movement and ships Android builds
summary: Co-op parties now share weapons, gadgets, packs, gold bolts and unlocked planets. Bolt drops come from the host's world, fly to the nearest player and show their pickup flight to other players. Remote figures and world objects move more smoothly over slow connections, standing figures stop bobbing, and held-item animations blend between updates. Multiplayer v0.7.1 and v0.7.3 were released, with the latter built against SDK 1.10.1 for Android support.
highlights: The public OpenRAC server becomes the default, while a private server remains configurable. Rapid Ready toggles no longer get overwritten by stale host updates.
Contributors can simulate latency and jitter with `OPENRAC_MP_LAG` and inspect detailed movement logs.
Android builds accompany difficulty v1.2.3, item-randomizer v1.0.3, lock-strafe v1.0.2, live-splits v1.0.2, keyboard-mouse v1.2.4, ammo-max v1.0.2, xbox-icons v1.0.1 and dualsense v1.0.2.
Earlier releases include difficulty v1.2.2, button-swap v1.0.0 and xbox-icons v1.0.0. The Android patch-version changes themselves leave mod code unchanged.
Documentation records unresolved decisions around individual saves, differing gameplay mods, randomizer seeds, host departure and mixed regions.
